name: Pro Record Page
description: Salesforce-style record page: key-field header, typed inline-editable fields (text, email, phone, money, number, date, picklist) validated per field with zod, dirty tracking with batch or per-field save, optimistic updates with rollback, related-record tabs and an embedded activity timeline slot.

examples.title: Opportunity with related lists and activity

props.name: queryKey
props.description: TanStack Query cache key of the record.

props.name: record
props.description: Initial data; the source of truth when loadRecord is omitted.

props.name: loadRecord
props.description: Server fetch; the record is refetched after each save.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Persist changed fields (phones normalised to E.164). Reject to roll back; edits come back as dirty.

props.name: fields
props.description: { name, label, type, required?, readOnly?, section?, wide?, options?, currency?, defaultCountry?, min?, max?, help?, schema? }

props.name: titleField
props.description: Field used as the page title.

props.name: headerFields
props.description: Key fields in the header strip.

props.name: saveMode
props.description: Batch with a save bar and Ctrl/Cmd+S (default), or save each field on commit.

props.name: tab / defaultTab / onTabChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled active tab. Default "details".

props.name: queryClient
props.description: Explicit client; otherwise the nearest provider or a private one.

usage: <ProRecordPage queryKey={["deal", id]} record={deal} fields={fields} titleField="name" onSave={api.patchDeal} />
